Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

slurmpilot 0.5.0

Security Hardening & Independent Peer Red-Team Remediation

  • Eliminated cli Glue {...} RCE (R/globals.R, R/efficiency.R): Audited every cli:: call package-wide so untrusted dynamic warnings and efficiency recommendations are interpolated safely via {w} / {r} without evaluating embedded R expressions.
  • Hardened #SBATCH, SSH, SCP, URL & Path Confinement Guards (R/security.R, R/backend_ssh.R, R/sbatch.R, R/apptainer.R, R/env_scan.R):
    • Blocked --wrap, --prolog/--epilog, --output/--error, --export, quotes, and multi-flag smuggling in extra_sbatch, and disallowed spaces in SLURM/container paths (sp_assert_safe_path(allow_spaces = FALSE)).
    • Blocked dangerous SSH CLI flags (-F, -S, -L/-R/-D/-W, -A, -J, -i, plus bundled variants) and directives (IdentityFile, ControlPath, ProxyJump, ForwardAgent, SendEnv, SetEnv, etc.) in ssh_options, and blocked whitespace/shell metacharacters in build_scp_args().
    • Hardened sp_assert_path_confined() via ancestor Sys.readlink() resolution against non-existent .. paths and dangling external symlinks, and enforced root confinement in scan_project_env().
    • Blocked $VAR shell expansion in cran_repo URLs and omitted empty apt-get blocks in build_apptainer_def().
  • Ambient Secret Scrubbing & Closure Audit Safety (R/globals.R, R/pilot.R, R/backend_mock.R, R/shiny_submit.R, R/sbatch.R):
    • Guarded inspect_job_globals() against evaluating active bindings, used serialize() for accurate nested-environment sizing, and added nested credential scanning ($secret_objects, $active_bindings).
    • Added default scrub_secrets = TRUE to pilot_run(), MockSlurmBackend, mock_slurm_backend(), and async Shiny pilots (scrubbing ambient credential env vars and setting R_ENVIRON_USER = "" / R_PROFILE_USER = ""), forwarded explicit job_spec$env_vars to mock workers, warned on secret env_vars in render_sbatch_script(), and applied 0600 permissions to written .sbatch files.

Container, Cluster, Pipeline, Parser, Shiny & Performance Fixes

  • Native rcapsule Interoperability (R/container_hook.R): use_rcapsule_container() now natively consumes rcapsule_apptainer_spec, rcapsule_apptainer, rcapsule_manifest, rcapsule_bundle, and rcapsule_export objects (def_content, def_sha256, bind_paths, integrity$content_digest, specs$apptainer, directory bundle .def files) with zero hard dependency.
  • POSIX Tilde Expansion & Apptainer --cleanenv Forwarding (R/sbatch.R, R/backend_ssh.R):
    • remote_dir = "~/..." now expands via "$HOME"/'...' across mkdir, sbatch, WORK_DIR, and --bind, with home-relative #SBATCH --output / --error paths.
    • Exported APPTAINERENV_* counterparts for thread caps, SLURMPILOT_*, and user env_vars (including SLURMPILOT_CONTAINER_DIGEST) whenever running under apptainer exec --cleanenv.
  • Scheduler, Pipeline & Efficiency Correctness (R/backend_ssh.R, R/pipeline.R, R/efficiency.R, R/backend_base.R):
    • Preserved per-job container_binds in SlurmSshBackend$retry() and rejected DRY_RUN dependencies on live (dry_run = FALSE) submissions.
    • Fixed slurm_pipeline_run() to reject unsupported wait = FALSE DAGs on MockSlurmBackend, honor stop_on_failure and "SKIPPED"/"OUT_OF_MEMORY"/ "TIMEOUT" in afterany/afternotok, and gracefully mark 0-task dynamic stages "SKIPPED".
    • Hardened slurm_efficiency_report() against missing chunk_id, Inf metrics in plot(), zero-median straggler ratios (Inf), and 100%-failed jobs (classification = "failed").
    • Union-aligned heterogeneous data-frame results in slurm_collect(simplify = TRUE).
  • Parser Safety, Shiny Resilience & LPT Speedup (R/utils.R, R/backend_ssh.R, R/shiny_submit.R, R/resources.R, R/sbatch.R):
    • Added max_indices = 100000L bound to parse_slurm_array_spec(), vectorized parse_squeue_output() to O(N)O(N), and preserved SLURM signal exit codes (128 + signal) in parse_sacct_output().
    • Wrapped mod_hpc_submit_server() pilot/submission observers in tryCatch() so empty or failing args_builder callbacks surface clean UI alerts instead of crashing the Shiny session.
    • Gated SLURMPILOT_MOCK_FAULT in worker.R strictly to SLURMPILOT_BACKEND=mock.
    • Accelerated plan_chunks(..., strategy = "lpt") via C-level which.min() plus an O(Nlog⁡M)O(N \log M) binary min-heap for > 2048 chunks and eliminated duplicate partitioning in estimate_resources() and scale_resources().

slurmpilot 0.4.0

New Research-Workflow Capabilities

  • Multi-Stage Dependent HPC Job DAGs (slurm_stage(), slurm_pipeline(), slurm_pipeline_run(), slurm_pipeline_status(), slurm_pipeline_collect()): Define linear, fan-out, fan-in, and diamond job DAGs with Kahn topological sorting and explicit cycle/self-loop detection. Emits validated SLURM #SBATCH --dependency=afterok:<ids> flags (afterok, afterany, afternotok) on SlurmSshBackend and executes full multi-stage pipelines locally end-to-end on MockSlurmBackend with upstream output forwarding.
  • Post-Mortem Resource Efficiency Auditor (slurm_efficiency_report(), plot.slurmpilot_efficiency()): Compares requested --mem and --time against empirical Peak RSS and walltime from MockSlurmBackend telemetry or parse_sacct_output() tables, quantifying memory waste %, walltime slack %, and straggler imbalance ratio, and recommending a concrete tightened (or escalated) resource_spec() for the next run.
  • Zero-Dependency Container Integration Hook (use_rcapsule_container()): Accepts .sif / .def file paths, slurmpilot_apptainer_def recipes, or duck-typed rcapsule specs/manifests (with zero hard dependency) to validate paths and bind mounts strictly and attach provenance metadata and SLURMPILOT_CONTAINER_DIGEST to slurm_job_spec().

Coverage-Driven Bug Fixes & Quality

  • Fixed subscript-out-of-bounds crash in verify_checkpoint() when a .sha256 sidecar file is blank or whitespace-only.
  • Fixed parse_sacct_output() and parse_squeue_output() misparsing non-numeric header rows when raw headered scheduler output is passed.
  • Fixed MockSlurmBackend$retry() dropping container_sif, modules, and env_vars when regenerating retry_<k>.sbatch and carrying over previous attempt peak_rss_mb.
  • Fixed mod_hpc_monitor_server() wiping collected results() on an accidental retry click against an already-COMPLETED job.
  • Added a fifth executable vignette (vignettes/pipelines-and-efficiency.Rmd) and drove test suite coverage above 93% via covr.

slurmpilot 0.3.0

Workflow Hardening & New Capabilities

  • Adaptive Retry Escalation (slurm_retry(), slurm_retry_history()): Automatically escalates --mem (default 1.5x, capped at max_mem_mb) on OUT_OF_MEMORY chunks and --time (default 1.5x, capped at max_time_minutes) on TIMEOUT chunks, while persisting per-chunk retry provenance to job$retry_history and retry_history.json.
  • Heterogeneous Task Load Balancing (plan_chunks(), resource_spec(), estimate_resources()): Added strategy = c("contiguous", "round_robin", "lpt") supporting Graham’s Longest Processing Time first greedy load balancing (with explicit task_weights or pilot-interpolated weights) so straggler chunks do not stall heterogeneous SLURM arrays.
  • Pre-Submit Closure & Globals Audit (inspect_job_globals()): Detects accidentally captured large closure objects (>= size_warn_mb), unresolved free variables, and unexported helper functions before staging, with automatic bundle-size warnings in slurm_job_spec().
  • Hardened SLURM Parsers & Transient SSH Backoff: Extended parse_slurm_mem() for SLURM per-CPU/per-node (100Mc, 200Mn, 4Gc) and IEC suffixes, extended parse_slurm_time() for fractional seconds and D-HH formats, exported parse_slurm_array_spec() (including stepped ranges 1-100:2 and %limit caps), hardened parse_sacct_output() / parse_squeue_output(), and added bounded exponential backoff retries for transient SSH/SCP network errors in SlurmSshBackend.

CRAN Readiness, Documentation & Website

  • Migrated vignettes to CRAN-universal VignetteBuilder: knitr (knitr::rmarkdown) and expanded to 4 executable vignettes (getting-started, pilot-to-cluster, apptainer-ssh-shiny, troubleshooting-and-retries).
  • Added inst/CITATION, runnable example scripts in inst/examples/, inst/WORDLIST (0 spelling warnings), cran-comments.md, and GitHub Actions workflows (R-CMD-check.yaml, pkgdown.yaml).
  • Added _pkgdown.yml website configuration and standalone PDF Field Guide source (inst/guides/slurmpilot-guide.Rmd).
  • Audited all examples, tests, and vignettes for strict <= 2 core limits, clean tempdir() cleanup, and zero global-state mutation.

slurmpilot 0.2.0

Security Hardening

  • Added centralized injection-defense and path-confinement module (R/security.R) and documented threat model & audit remediations in SECURITY.md.
  • Hardened render_sbatch_script(), resource_spec(), estimate_resources(), and slurm_job_spec() against #SBATCH newline/control-char injection, shell metacharacters, --wrap smuggling, unsafe module/env names, and path traversal (..).
  • Hardened build_ssh_args(), build_scp_args(), build_scancel_command(), and SlurmSshBackend with strict host/user/path/job-ID validation, explicit -- option delimiters, and a denylist blocking dangerous SSH execution directives (ProxyCommand, LocalCommand, RemoteCommand, Include, Match).
  • Hardened build_apptainer_def() and scan_project_env() against container base-image, R/apt package name, CRAN URL, version string, label, and %post section-breakout injection.
  • Added atomic SHA-256 checkpoint sidecars (chunk_XXXX.rds.sha256) and exported verify_checkpoint(), enforced automatically by slurm_collect() and worker.R idempotent resume checks.
  • Eliminated .Random.seed mutation from job ID generation and atomic file writers.
  • Hardened Shiny modules (mod_hpc_submit_*, mod_hpc_monitor_*) with finite input clamping, retry caps, memory ceilings, isolated zero-loop polling, and ANSI/XSS-safe text sanitization (sp_escape_ui_text()).

Profiling Accuracy, Parallel RNG & Process Lifecycle

  • Upgraded estimate_resources() walltime estimation with a robust heavy-tail envelope combining normal CLT, Fenton-Wilkinson log-normal sum quantiles, and nonparametric order-statistic bounds, plus overflow-safe sub-millisecond task sizing and pilot failure/OOM diagnostics.
  • Switched worker.R and pilot_run() from consecutive integer seeds to independent hierarchical L'Ecuyer-CMRG streams (parallel::nextRNGStream() + parallel::nextRNGSubStream()) and exported slurmpilot_rng_stream().
  • Added sp_kill_and_reap() and MockSlurmBackend$shutdown() for guaranteed child-process reaping and race-safe status transitions on cancel, OOM, timeout, and completion.

slurmpilot 0.1.0

  • Initial release featuring empirical micro-pilot profiling (pilot_run(), estimate_resources()), HPC environment scanning and Apptainer/SLURM generation (scan_project_env(), build_apptainer_def(), render_sbatch_script(), render_worker_script()), pluggable scheduler backends (MockSlurmBackend, SlurmSshBackend), and non-blocking bslib/Shiny offload modules (mod_hpc_submit_*, mod_hpc_monitor_*, run_demo_app()).
